semantics.owner_investment_not_external_investor: Owner investment commitments are retained as investment facts but not relabeled as third-party investors.

semantics.secondary_sources: Secondary public registries are retained when they provide a concrete site-level linkage; source class remains explicit.
semantics.uncertainty: A source that does not establish a quantity remains non-quantitative rather than being converted into a numeric estimate.
